# EnlitEDU - LioraAI

> EnlitEDU builds LioraAI, AI transcript evaluation software for U.S. colleges and universities. Lead products: LioraAI Transfer Credit Intelligence (automated transfer credit evaluation) and LioraAI Freshman Intelligence (high school transcript automation). LioraAI evaluates transfer, first-year (freshman), military (JST/CCAF) and prior-learning (CPL/PLA) credit against each institution's own rules, gives students a self-service path to a degree, and provides transfer analytics. Staff and faculty approve every decision; approved credit is written back to the SIS (Banner, Colleague, Workday Student, PeopleSoft, Jenzabar).

Key facts: Roane State Community College cut transcript evaluation from about three weeks to two days (reported 90% faster) and went live on Ellucian Banner in 18 days. Nashville State Community College cut per-transcript evaluation time from about 15 minutes to 2 minutes (87%) and approval turnaround from 18 to 8 hours (56%) after going live in July 2026. Student records are never used to train general-purpose AI models. EnlitEDU acts as a FERPA school official under the institution's control. Headquarters: Cumming, Georgia. Contact: info@enlitedu.com.

Leadership: Chaitanya Saripalli, Founder & CEO of EnlitEDU (https://www.linkedin.com/in/chaitanyasaripalli/). Module names: LioraAI Transfer Credit Intelligence (formerly Articulate) for transfer credit evaluation; LioraAI Freshman Intelligence (formerly Assess) for freshman / first-year transcript evaluation.

Where we work: colleges, universities, technical colleges and state systems across the United States. Demos, implementation and training run online in every state. Georgia/Atlanta pages below are regional guides, not a service limit.

## Modules
- [LioraAI Transfer Credit Intelligence](https://www.enlitedu.com/transfer-credit-intelligence.html): Evaluate transfer credit in days, not weeks. LioraAI Transfer Credit Intelligence maps any transcript to your catalog and rules, then posts credit to your SIS.
- [LioraAI Freshman Intelligence](https://www.enlitedu.com/freshman-intelligence.html): Evaluate every freshman applicant’s transcript the same way. LioraAI Freshman Intelligence standardizes 4.0, 5.0, 6.0 and 100-point GPAs with your rules.
- [Prior Learning Assessment](https://www.enlitedu.com/pla.html): Award credit for prior learning (CPL/PLA) consistently: certifications, workforce training, CLEP/DSST and portfolios mapped to your courses, faculty approving.
- [LioraAI for Veterans & JST](https://www.enlitedu.com/veterans.html): Evaluate Joint Services Transcripts, CCAF and DD-214 records against ACE recommendations and your catalog. Give veterans a credit answer in days, not a semester.
- [Student Degree Pathway](https://www.enlitedu.com/degree-pathway.html): Give every student a clear, credit-accurate path to their degree. LioraAI Student Degree Pathway shows what transferred, what counts and what’s left, term by term.
- [Student Mobility Intelligence](https://www.enlitedu.com/mobility.html): See where transfer students come from, how much credit they lose and who may leave. Mobility Intelligence turns evaluation data into enrollment strategy.

## Solutions
- [Speed Up Credit Evaluation](https://www.enlitedu.com/solutions/speed-up-credit-evaluation.html): Clear the transcript backlog without adding staff. LioraAI turns weeks of manual credit evaluation into same-week decisions your team reviews and approves.
- [Grow Transfer Enrollment](https://www.enlitedu.com/solutions/grow-transfer-enrollment.html): Transfer students shop for credit. Give them a fast, accurate answer before they apply, and turn evaluation data into stronger partner pathways.
- [Serve Military & Adult Learners](https://www.enlitedu.com/solutions/serve-military-and-adult-learners.html): Give veterans and adult learners credit for what they already know: JST, CCAF, certifications and portfolios, with ACE citations and faculty approval.
- [Stay Consistent & Audit-Ready](https://www.enlitedu.com/solutions/stay-audit-ready.html): Make every credit decision consistent and documented: your rules applied every time, with evidence kept for FERPA, accreditation and VA reviews.
- [Improve Completion & Retention](https://www.enlitedu.com/solutions/improve-completion-and-retention.html): Students who can see their path to a degree are more likely to finish. LioraAI gives students and advisors a current, credit-accurate plan.

## Who we serve
- [Community Colleges](https://www.enlitedu.com/who-we-serve/community-colleges.html): Built with community college registrars: faster transfer-in evaluations, credit for prior learning, military credit, transfer-out pathways and reverse transfer.
- [Four-Year Universities](https://www.enlitedu.com/who-we-serve/four-year-universities.html): One platform for universities: freshman transcript and GPA standardization, transfer credit evaluation for transfer admits, and student degree pathways.
- [HBCUs & MSIs](https://www.enlitedu.com/who-we-serve/hbcus-and-msis.html): Fair, consistent credit evaluation for HBCUs and minority-serving institutions: transfer students, adult learners and veterans served quickly by lean teams.
- [State Systems & Consortia](https://www.enlitedu.com/who-we-serve/state-systems.html): One set of transfer rules across every campus: consistent evaluation, shared articulation data and system-wide mobility analytics for systems and consortia.

## Guides (national, each with a short Georgia section; Georgia is the headquarters state, not a service limit)
- [Transcript & Credit Evaluation Software](https://www.enlitedu.com/georgia.html): LioraAI is transcript and credit evaluation software for colleges across the U.S., from a team headquartered in Cumming, Georgia. Georgia rules included.
- [Transcript Evaluation Software](https://www.enlitedu.com/georgia/atlanta-transcript-evaluation.html): EnlitEDU builds LioraAI transcript and credit evaluation software in metro Atlanta for colleges across the U.S. Online demos anywhere, on-campus visits on request.
- [Freshman Transcript Evaluation Guide for Colleges](https://www.enlitedu.com/georgia/freshman-transcript-evaluation.html): How colleges evaluate freshman transcripts: GPA standardization, AP/IB/Honors weighting, dual enrollment credit and state scholarship GPAs such as Georgia’s HOPE.
- [Transfer Credit Evaluation by State Rules: U.S. & Georgia](https://www.enlitedu.com/georgia/transfer-credit-evaluation.html): Transfer credit evaluation that applies state rules, from common course numbering to Georgia’s Core IMPACTS and TCSG-USG agreement, then posts credit to your SIS.
- [Military Transcript Evaluation Guide: JST & CCAF](https://www.enlitedu.com/georgia/military-transcript-evaluation.html): How colleges evaluate JST, CCAF and DD-214 records with ACE recommendations and state military-credit rules, with School Certifying Official review.
- [Transcript evaluation near me](https://www.enlitedu.com/transcript-evaluation-near-me.html): Searching “transcript evaluation near me”? See which you need: LioraAI software for colleges across the U.S., or a credential evaluation for your own transcript.
- Georgia rules LioraAI supports: USG Core IMPACTS (42-hour general education core in seven areas; credit transfers area to area between USG institutions), the TCSG-USG general education transfer agreement, Georgia Dual Enrollment college credit, the HOPE GPA calculated by the Georgia Student Finance Commission (distinct from an admissions GPA), and JST/CCAF transcripts from Georgia military installations.
- EnlitEDU provides software to institutions; it does not evaluate individual students' transcripts.
